title: Fidget
kicker: a restless child guide who knows the fastest ways through the village
hook: a restless child guide who knows the fastest ways through the village

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A small goblin guide grins under a mop of green-black hair, layered in beads, little bells, festival cloth, and trinkets that clink before they arrive.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Restless, sharp, and starved to be useful before the grown-ups decide the useful part is over. Reads people fast and forgives slow. The bead strings are a walking map only Fidget can fully read: blue for water, brass for tolls, bone-white for the places...

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A route A local question A reminder that Hush is lived-in
